name: Configurable End Raid Status
teaser: A simple mod that allows you to change the raid exit statuses to something else (e.g MIA to survived)
description_html:
Hate it when the raid ends with 1 second left to extract?

Sick and tired of having to commit fully to a raid when something comes up?

Look no further, this mod has got you covered.

This is a simple mod that allows you to set whatever raid status you desire for each of the raid statuses in-game;

You can set MIA will to survived (so you extract even when the timer runs out).

You can make it out safely even when your character falls over from a grenade.

Or you can even set survived status to left the action if you like to live on the edge

The choices are yours.

For the ‘survived’ option, there is a toggle to enable/disable it just incase.

Installation is simple;

Just open the zip and drag and drop the bepinex folder into your spt install
